- [Create an image](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/post-image.md): Captures a private, gold image from a Linode disk and stores it for later use.  > 👍 There's a tutorial > > This operation has specific requirements for use. Check out its [workflow](ref:capture-an-image) for details.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **Identity and access permissions**. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/identity-access-cm-available-roles).   - Permissions: `create_image` - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write, linodes:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli images create \   --label this_is_a_label \   --description "A longer description \     of the image" \   --disk_id 123 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [List images](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-images.md): Returns a paginated list of images. An image can be one of two types:  - **Public image**. The `id` for these images begins with `linode/`. These images are generally available to all users. To limit the response to public images, don't include [authentication](ref:get-started#authentication) when calling this operation.  - **Private image**. The `id` for these images begins with `private/`. These images are account-specific and only accessible to users with appropriate permissions. To view private images, you need to include authentication when calling this operation. The response includes both private and public images.  - **Shared image**. The `id` for these images begins with `shared/`. These are the images that are shared with the user.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **Identity and access permissions**. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/identity-access-cm-available-roles).   - Permissions: `Public images are Internet facing and private images require the view_image permission` - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli images list ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Upload an image](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/post-upload-image.md): Creates a new private image container and returns a URL as the `upload_to` object in the response. Use this URL to upload your own disk image to the container.  > 👍 There's a tutorial > > This operation has specific requirements for use. Check out its [workflow](ref:upload-an-image) for details.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **Identity and access permissions**. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/identity-access-cm-available-roles).   - Permissions: `upload_image` - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell # Run the operation to just get the upload_to URL linode-cli images upload \   --description "Optional details about the Image" \   --label "Example Image" \   --region us-east  # Upload the image file in a single step linode-cli image-upload \   --description "Optional details about the Image" \   --label "Example Image" \   --region us-east \   /path/to/image-file.img.gz ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Get an image](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-image.md): Get information about a single image. An image can be one of two types:  - **Public image**. The `id` for these images begins with `linode/`. These images are generally available to all users. To limit the response to public images, don't include [authentication](ref:get-started#authentication) when calling this operation.  - **Private image**. The `id` for these images begins with `private/`. These images are account-specific and only accessible to users with appropriate permissions. To view private images, you need to include authentication when calling this operation. The response will also include public images.  - **Shared image**. The `id` for these images begins with `shared/`. These are the images that are shared with the user.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **Identity and access permissions**. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/identity-access-cm-available-roles).   - Permissions: `view_image` - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli images view linode/debian13 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Update an image](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/put-image.md): Updates a private image.  > 📘 > > You can't update the `regions` with this operation. Use the [Replicate an image](ref:post-replicate-image) operation to modify the existing regions for your image.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **Identity and access permissions**. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/identity-access-cm-available-roles).   - Permissions: `update_image` - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli images update private/12345 \   --label "My gold image" \   --description "The detailed description \     of my image." ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Delete an image](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/delete-image.md): Deletes a private image.  > 🚧 > > - You can't undo this delete action. > > - When you delete an image, all [replicated instances](ref:post-replicate-image) of that image are also deleted.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **Identity and access permissions**. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/identity-access-cm-available-roles).   - Permissions: `delete_image` - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli images delete 12345 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Replicate an image](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/post-replicate-image.md): Target an existing image and replicate it to another compute region.  > 📘 > > As part of our limited promotional period, image replicas are free of charge until November 1, 2025. After this date, replicas will be subject to our standard monthly rate of $0.10/GB. When replicas become billable, your monthly charge will be calculated using the value returned in `total_size`, divided by 100. [Learn more](https://www.linode.com/blog/compute/image-service-improvements-akamai-cdn/).  - This is only available in a `region` that supports Object Storage, which stores the replicated image. Run the [List regions](ref:get-regions) operation to review a region's `capabilities`.  - To replicate an image, it needs to have a `status` of `available`. Run the [List images](ref:get-images) operation to view an image's `status`.  - To also keep the target image in its original compute region, you need to include that `region` in the request's data. If you leave it out, the API removes the image from that region. Run the [Get an image](ref:get-image) operation to see the `regions` where an image currently exists.  - You can't include an empty array to delete all images. You need to provide at least one compute `region` where the image is `available`. Use the [Delete an image](ref:delete-image) operation.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **Identity and access permissions**. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/identity-access-cm-available-roles).   - Permissions: `replicate_image` - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli images replicate private/12345 \   --regions "us-mia" \   --regions "us-east" ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Create a share group](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/post-sharegroups.md): __Beta__ Creates a group to share images with other users.  - Include existing `images` in the request or [Add images to a share group](ref:post-sharegroup-images) later. Run the [Get an image](ref:get-image) operation to see the existing images' `id` values. If needed, [Create an image](ref:post-image) or [Upload an image](ref:post-upload-image).  - You can set a `label` and `description` for the group and each image, visible to all group members.  - If omitted, the shared image keeps the original `label` and `description`. Note that when you [Update the original image](ref:put-image), it has no effect on shared image's details within any groups.  - Run the [Add members to a share group](ref:post-sharegroup-members) to include other users in the group. Use the group's `uuid` from the response to [Create a token](ref:post-sharegroup-tokens) for user authentication.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups create --label "my_label" --description "my_description" \   --images '[{"id": "private/15", "label": "Linux Debian", "description": "Official Debian Linux image for server deployment"}]' ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [List share groups](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-sharegroups.md): __Beta__ Lists all owned groups with shared images.  > 📘 > > This operation doesn't list groups you're a member of. Run [Get a token's share group](ref:get-sharegroup-by-token) to find these share groups using your membership token.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups list ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Create a token](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/post-sharegroup-tokens.md): __Beta__ Creates a single-use membership token for users who want to join a share group with custom images.  - Before creating a token, get the share group's UUID from its owner. The owner can run [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) or [Get a share group](ref:get-sharegroup) to get the group's UUID. If needed, [Create a share group](ref:post-sharegroups) and share the UUID with the user.  - Share the `token` from the response with the share group owner. The owner can later use the token to [Add members to a share group](ref:post-sharegroup-members) and manage the users' membership within the group.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups token-create --label "my_token" --valid_for_sharegroup_uuid "abc123" ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [List a user's tokens](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-user-tokens.md): __Beta__ Get details about all the user's tokens.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups tokens-list ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Get a token's share group](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-sharegroup-by-token.md): __Beta__ Gets details about a share group you're a member of.  To get the `token_uuid`, run the [Get a token](ref:get-sharegroup-token) or [Create a token](ref:post-sharegroup-tokens) for the share group you want to join and share it with the group owner. You have to be accepted as a share group member before running this operation.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups view-by-token abc123 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [List images by token](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-sharegroup-images-by-token.md): __Beta__ Lists all the shared images a member can access within a share group, using a membership token. To get the `token_uuid`, run the [Get a token](ref:get-sharegroup-token) operation.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups images-list-by-token abc123 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Get a share group](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-sharegroup.md): __Beta__ Get information about an owned share group. Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `sharegroupId` path parameter that identifies an existing share group. If the `sharegroupId` in the request body belongs to a group you don't own, calling this API will result in a 404 error.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups view 1234 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Update a share group](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/put-sharegroup.md): __Beta__ Updates the details of a share group you own. Run this operation to edit the `label` or `description` of a particular sharegroup.  - Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `(sharegroupId)` path parameter that identifies an existing share group.  - You can update either of the fields, but when you provide a new `label`, make sure that it's not an empty string.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups update 1234 --label "new_label" --description "A new description." ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Delete a share group](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/delete-sharegroup.md): __Beta__ Deletes an owned share group. All shared group members lose access to the images within the group upon deletion.  - Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `(sharegroupId)` path parameter that identifies an existing share group.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups delete 1234 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Add images to a share group](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/post-sharegroup-images.md): __Beta__ Adds images to an existing group where you can share them with other members.  - Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `(sharegroupId)` path parameter that identifies an existing share group.  - Run the [Get an image](ref:get-image) operation to see the existing images' `id` values. If needed, [Create an image](ref:post-image) or [Upload an image](ref:post-upload-image).  - You can set a `label` and `description` for each image, visible to all group members. If omitted, the shared image keeps the original image's details. Note that when you [Update the original image](ref:put-image), it has no effect on a shared image's details within any groups.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups image-add 123 \   --images '[{"id": "private/15", "label": "Linux Debian", "description": "Official Debian Linux image for server deployment"}]' ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [List shared images by group](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-sharegroup-images.md): __Beta__ Get the details about images shared in a particular group you own.  - Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `(sharegroupId)` path parameter that identifies an existing share group.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups images-list 123 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Update a shared image](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/put-sharegroup-imageshare.md): __Beta__ Updates the details of an image shared within a share group. Run this operation to edit the `label` and `description` of a particular shared image.  - Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `(sharegroupId)` path parameter that identifies an existing share group. To get the `imageID`, run the [List shared images by group](ref:get-sharegroup-images) operation.  - You can update either of the fields, but when you provide a new `label`, make sure that it's not an empty string.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups image-update 123 1234 --label "new_label" --description "A new description." ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Revoke access to a shared image](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/delete-sharegroup-imageshare.md): __Beta__ Revokes access to a shared image within an owned group for all members.  - Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `(sharegroupId)` path parameter that identifies an existing share group. To get the `imageID`, run the [List shared images by group](ref:get-sharegroup-images) operation.  - To add a private image back to a share group, run the [Add images to a share group](ref:post-sharegroup-images).  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups image-remove 123 1234 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Add members to a share group](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/post-sharegroup-members.md): __Beta__ Adds users to existing shared private image groups as a group owner.  - Adding new members to share groups requires a single-use token. The user who wants to join a share group should run [Create a token](ref:post-sharegroup-tokens) and share the `token` from the response with the group owner.  - Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `(sharegroupId)` path parameter that identifies an existing share group.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_write`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups member-add 123 --token "abc123" --label "my_sharegroup_member" ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [List members by share group](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-sharegroup-members.md): __Beta__ Get the details about all members in a particular share group you own.  - Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `(sharegroupId)` path parameter that identifies an existing share group.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups members-list 123 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Get a membership token](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-sharegroup-member-token.md): __Beta__ Get details about a membership token as a share group owner. Run this operation to check the `status` of a pending membership request or a current group member.  - Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `(sharegroupId)` path parameter that identifies an existing share group.  - Get the `token_uuid` from the user who wants to join your share group or run the [List members by share group](ref:get-sharegroup-members) operation for details on current group members.  - To get details about a token as a current or pending group member, run the [Get a token](ref:get-sharegroup-token) operation.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-started#oauth).    - Scopes: `images:read_only`   **CLI**  ```shell linode-cli image-sharegroups member-view 123 abc123 ```  [Learn more](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-linode-cli)
- [Update a membership token](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/put-sharegroup-member-token.md): __Beta__ Updates an existing membership token for a group owner. You can change each token's `label` that will be visible only to you, such as when you [Get members by share group](ref:get-sharegroup-members).  - Run the [List share groups](ref:get-sharegroups) operation to get the `id` you should use as the `(sharegroupId)` path parameter that identifies an existing share group.  - Run the [List members by share group](ref:get-sharegroup-members) operation to get the `token_uuid` for a current group member.  > 📘 > > This operation is in Beta and available from the `v4beta` URL.   **Permissions and scopes**  To call this operation, you need the following:  - **OAuth scopes**. Your user needs these scopes assigned. blocks.text: Create an image: Captures a private, gold image from a Linode disk and stores it for later use.  > 👍 There's a tutorial > > This operation has specific requirements for use. Check out its workflow for details.   Permissions and scopes  To call this operation, you need the following:  - Identity and access permissions. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. Learn more.   - Permissions: create_image - OAuth scopes. Your user needs these scopes assigned. Learn more.    - Scopes: images:read_write, linodes:read_only   CLI  shell linode-cli images create \   --label this_is_a_label \   --description "A longer description \     of the image" \   --disk_id 123   Learn moreList images: Returns a paginated list of images. An image can be one of two types:  - Public image. The id for these images begins with linode/. These images are generally available to all users. To limit the response to public images, don't include authentication when calling this operation.  - Private image. The id for these images begins with private/. These images are account-specific and only accessible to users with appropriate permissions. To view private images, you need to include authentication when calling this operation. The response includes both private and public images.  - Shared image. The id for these images begins with shared/. These are the images that are shared with the user.   Permissions and scopes  To call this operation, you need the following:  - Identity and access permissions. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. Learn more.   - Permissions: Public images are Internet facing and private images require the view_image permission - OAuth scopes. Your user needs these scopes assigned. Learn more.    - Scopes: images:read_only   CLI  shell linode-cli images list   Learn moreUpload an image: Creates a new private image container and returns a URL as the upload_to object in the response. Use this URL to upload your own disk image to the container.  > 👍 There's a tutorial > > This operation has specific requirements for use. Check out its workflow for details.   Permissions and scopes  To call this operation, you need the following:  - Identity and access permissions. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. Learn more.   - Permissions: upload_image - OAuth scopes. Your user needs these scopes assigned. Learn more.    - Scopes: images:read_write   CLI  shell # Run the operation to just get the upload_to URL linode-cli images upload \   --description "Optional details about the Image" \   --label "Example Image" \   --region us-east  # Upload the image file in a single step linode-cli image-upload \   --description "Optional details about the Image" \   --label "Example Image" \   --region us-east \   /path/to/image-file.img.gz   Learn moreGet an image: Get information about a single image. An image can be one of two types:  - Public image. The id for these images begins with linode/. These images are generally available to all users. To limit the response to public images, don't include authentication when calling this operation.  - Private image. The id for these images begins with private/. These images are account-specific and only accessible to users with appropriate permissions. To view private images, you need to include authentication when calling this operation. The response will also include public images.  - Shared image. The id for these images begins with shared/. These are the images that are shared with the user.   Permissions and scopes  To call this operation, you need the following:  - Identity and access permissions. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. Learn more.   - Permissions: view_image - OAuth scopes. Your user needs these scopes assigned. Learn more.    - Scopes: images:read_only   CLI  shell linode-cli images view linode/debian13   Learn moreUpdate an image: Updates a private image.  > 📘 > > You can't update the regions with this operation. Use the Replicate an image operation to modify the existing regions for your image.   Permissions and scopes  To call this operation, you need the following:  - Identity and access permissions. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. Learn more.   - Permissions: update_image - OAuth scopes. Your user needs these scopes assigned. Learn more.    - Scopes: images:read_write   CLI  shell linode-cli images update private/12345 \   --label "My gold image" \   --description "The detailed description \     of my image."   Learn moreDelete an image: Deletes a private image.  > 🚧 > > - You can't undo this delete action. > > - When you delete an image, all replicated instances of that image are also deleted.   Permissions and scopes  To call this operation, you need the following:  - Identity and access permissions. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. Learn more.   - Permissions: delete_image - OAuth scopes. Your user needs these scopes assigned. Learn more.    - Scopes: images:read_write   CLI  shell linode-cli images delete 12345   Learn moreReplicate an image: Target an existing image and replicate it to another compute region.  > 📘 > > As part of our limited promotional period, image replicas are free of charge until November 1, 2025. After this date, replicas will be subject to our standard monthly rate of $0.10/GB. When replicas become billable, your monthly charge will be calculated using the value returned in total_size, divided by 100. Learn more.  - This is only available in a region that supports Object Storage, which stores the replicated image. Run the List regions operation to review a region's capabilities.  - To replicate an image, it needs to have a status of available. Run the List images operation to view an image's status.  - To also keep the target image in its original compute region, you need to include that region in the request's data. If you leave it out, the API removes the image from that region. Run the Get an image operation to see the regions where an image currently exists.  - You can't include an empty array to delete all images. You need to provide at least one compute region where the image is available. Use the Delete an image operation.   Permissions and scopes  To call this operation, you need the following:  - Identity and access permissions. Your user needs a role with these permissions assigned. Learn more.   - Permissions: replicate_image - OAuth scopes. Your user needs these scopes assigned. Learn more.    - Scopes: images:read_write   CLI  shell linode-cli images replicate private/12345 \   --regions "us-mia" \   --regions "us-east"   Learn moreCreate a share group: Beta Creates a group to share images with other users.  - Include existing images in the request or Add images to a share group later. Run the Get an image operation to see the existing images' id values. If needed, Create an image or Upload an image.  - You can set a label and description for the group and each image, visible to all group members.  - If omitted, the shared image keeps the original label and description.
